lead: Inzamam-ul-Haq is a widely followed Pakistani cricketer, born on 3 March 1970 in Multan.
As of 2026, he is 56 years old, and his birth date places him under the Pisces sign.
He has represented Pakistan national cricket team and Lahore Badshahs and has been recognised with the Sitara-i-Imtiaz.
